description: Le potentiel solaire des toitures is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by L'Institut Paris Region. La donnée représente le potentiel solaire des toitures en 2017 sur la bd topo de la même année. On retrouve dans la donnée un certain nombre d'indicateurs comme la nature du bâtiment, le type de gisement, ou l'équivalent en panneaux solaires. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Cadre de vie - environnement. Its keywords are Énergie, Développement durable. The portal shows 2026-01-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
